text:
Taylor: quick note—found a customer-facing ambiguity in metering.md: we say 'requests are billed at the plan tier' but billing is actually token-level and can be split across tiers when an override header is used. users are confused by dashboard rows showing multiple tiers.
Ivy: ugh yeah that wording is leftover. can you suggest replacement copy?
Taylor: proposed line: 'Billing is calculated per token. Tokens are attributed to a tier based on the API key by default; an optional override header can attribute some tokens to a different tier for that request.'
Ben: add a one-line example showing split attribution and call out that routing fallbacks (model variants) do not change billing attribution unless the header/api-key changes.
Taylor: added example snippet:
```
# billing window: 2026-07-01
API key tier: standard -> 1,000 tokens
Requests with X-Redwood-Client-Tier: pro -> 250 tokens
Result: 1,000 tokens billed at standard rate, 250 tokens billed at pro rate.
```
Ivy: tiny nit: use 'override tier' instead of 'pro rate' to avoid implying discounts. Also migrate header name note: old header `X-Plan` -> new `X-Redwood-Client-Tier`.
Taylor: good call. adding migration note and a short curl/python snippet for the docs:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Redwood-Client-Tier: pro" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
```python
import requests
requests.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/completions', json={'prompt':'hi'}, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {KEY}', 'X-Redwood-Client-Tier':'pro'})
```
Ben: perfect. also fix the sidebar link—docs-ci-bot shows `/billing/tiers` 404; switch to `/pricing/tiers` and add a docs-test asserting the path resolves.
docs-ci-bot: link-check: 1 broken link found in docs/metering.md -> /billing/tiers (404). suggested replacement: /pricing/tiers.
Taylor: will patch copy, snippets, link, and add the test. opening PR now and tagging for review. PR: https://git.redwood.com/redwood/docs/pull/1045 (copy + snippets + link fix + test). cc @Ivy @Ben
Ivy: will review this afternoon, keep language concise.
Ben: LGTM pending the header-migration sentence.
Taylor: added migration sentence and pushed. merging after CI passes. :rocket:
